description: Cycling - commuter routes (N Somerset) is a dataset listed in Open Data Bristol, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by North Somerset Council www.betterbybike.info. Key named cycling routes in the North Somerset local authority. Many of these include significant amounts of dedicated cycling infrastructure (such as off-road cycle tracks). Coverage: Bristol. The portal files it under Transport & Streets, Leisure & Tourism. Its keywords are North Somerset Council, Cycle Network, Cycling, Bike, transport, Better By Bike. The portal shows 5 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2018-10-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is OGL-UK-3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-bristol-gov-uk-portal.
